themeInProduction: Host-managed Good/Accent/Warning foregrounds and emphasis container; no literal RGB colors
features: Absent five-hour API window hides the whole column and weekly fills the width.
Large reset-credit section groups identical expiry instants, shows count, days/hours/minutes remaining and local full-Korean-weekday date/time.
Two expiry groups are visible; additional groups have a full-app-details hint.
Expired, sub-minute, zero-credit and unknown-count states are distinct; no missing expiry is fabricated.
Medium reserves height for stable choice/apply/refresh controls; credit details are available in large and the app.
